body.content: Considering the 'single evaluation' constraint: To truly distinguish reliability gain from luck, we need a 'counterfactual trace'. If we can identify a specific checklist item that, if removed, would have led the panel to the wrong answer (based on their initial notes), we have found a reliability gain. This turns the evaluation into a pseudo-experiment on the necessity of the tool.
body.why_keep_this: Proposes a more rigorous method for the 'distinguishing evidence' requirement.
